Setup mode. ENFORCED to `Project_Only` (constant, not prompted) so new projects created inside the
monorepo only ever scaffold squad code under domains/<tribe>/<squad>.

The other modes stay available for override via --config-file only, they are not offered interactively:
  - `Project_Only`      : (enforced default) scaffold squad code, no CI/CD. What data scientists use.
  - `CICD_and_Project`  : project + CI/CD in one dir. Standalone-repo layout; avoid inside the monorepo
                          (its .github would land under the squad path, where GitHub Actions won't run it).
  - `CICD_Only`         : generate only the CI/CD workflows. Optional escape hatch for a squad that wants
                          fully independent per-project workflows outside the shared deployment-repo kit
                          (the primary CI/CD path — see docs/architecture-decisions.md ADR-15/ADR-16).

input_tribe.description:
Tribe (business-aligned team) that owns this project, e.g. cdi. The default is a generic
placeholder — set your real tribe. Drives the monorepo path domains/<tribe>/<squad>, the UC
schema, model name, and the Tribe tag.
input_tribe.pattern_match_failure_message: Tribe must be lower_snake_case: start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

input_squad.description:
Squad (delivery unit within the tribe) that owns this project, e.g. promo.
Drives the monorepo path domains/<tribe>/<squad>, the UC schema, model name, and the Squad tag.
Default
input_squad.pattern_match_failure_message: Squad must be lower_snake_case: start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

input_domain.description:
Data/analytics domain this project is about, e.g. sales, customer. A domain typically contains
several tribes (domain is the broader org grouping; tribe is a team within it). The default is a
generic placeholder — set your real domain. Applied as the Domain tag so assets are discoverable
by domain even though the repo path stays team-first (tribe/squad only — domain is metadata, not
a folder level).
Default
input_domain.pattern_match_failure_message: Domain must be lower_snake_case: start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

input_project_name.description:
Project name (identity key). Derived as <tribe>_<squad> and not prompted, so the identity
stays consistent across repo path, UC schema, model, experiment, and tags.
Default
input_project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Project name must be at least 3 characters long and cannot contain the following characters: "\", "/", " " and ".".

input_root_dir.description:
Root directory for this project inside the monorepo. Enforced to domains/<tribe>/<squad>
so new projects always land in the team/squad structure.
Default

input_cloud.description: Cloud provider (locked to AWS for this template)

input_cicd_platform.description: CI/CD platform (locked to GitHub Actions for this template)

input_databricks_dev_workspace_host.description:
URL of the dev_qa Databricks workspace (its own separate workspace — not shared with UAT or prod).
Mapped to the bundle `dev` target.
Default
input_databricks_dev_workspace_host.pattern_match_failure_message: Databricks dev_qa workspace host URLs must start with https. Got invalid workspace host.

input_databricks_staging_workspace_host.description:
URL of the UAT Databricks workspace (its own separate workspace — not shared with dev_qa or prod).
Mapped to the bundle `staging` target.
Default
input_databricks_staging_workspace_host.pattern_match_failure_message: Databricks staging workspace host URLs must start with https. Got invalid workspace host.

input_databricks_prod_workspace_host.description:
URL of the production Databricks workspace. Mapped to the bundle `prod` target.
Not used during the dev_qa-only PoC; kept here so prod can be enabled later.
Default
input_databricks_prod_workspace_host.pattern_match_failure_message: Databricks production workspace host URLs must start with https. Got invalid workspace host.

input_default_branch.description:
Name of the default branch,
Staging resources are deployed from this branch and stages the latest ML code.
Default

input_release_branch.description:
Name of the release branch.
The training and other production jobs pull ML code from this branch.
Default

input_read_user_group.description:
User group name to give READ permissions to for project resources
(ML jobs, integration test job runs, and machine learning resources).
A group with this name must exist in both the staging and prod workspaces.
Default

input_staging_catalog_name.description:
Name of the Unity Catalog for the UAT environment (mapped to the `staging` target).
Consumption/Gold layer per the org medallion guide. Confirm the real UAT catalog name. Must exist with SP access.
Default

input_prod_catalog_name.description:
Name of the Unity Catalog for the production environment (mapped to the `prod` target).
Dormant until prod is enabled — confirm the real prod consumption catalog name first.
Default

input_test_catalog_name.description:
Name of the Unity Catalog used for integration tests. Runs in dev_qa during the PoC.
Must already exist with SP access.
Default

input_schema_name.description:
Unity Catalog schema for registering models, feature tables, and experiments.
Enforced to <tribe>_<squad> so the schema matches the project identity. Must already exist with SP access.
Default
input_schema_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Valid schema names cannot contain any of the following characters: " ", ".", "-", "\", "/"

input_unity_catalog_read_user_group.description:
User group name to give EXECUTE privileges to models in Unity Catalog (UC).
It must exist in UC with access granted to the staging and prod workspaces.
Default

input_inference_table_name.description:
Fully qualified name of inference table to attach monitoring to.
This table must already exist and service principals must have access.
input_inference_table_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Fully qualified Unity Catalog table names must have catalog, schema, and table separated by "." and each cannot contain any of the following characters: " ", ".", "-", "\", "/"

input_project_skeleton.description:
Project skeleton to scaffold.
  - `mlops_stacks_native` (default): the standard training/deployment/validation/monitoring
    layout used throughout this template.
  - `kedro`: a Kedro pipeline project (src/<project>/pipelines/{data_processing,model_training,
    model_inference}, conf/, pyproject.toml) instead. Jobs run via a python_wheel_task calling
    `kedro run` rather than notebook_task. input_include_feature_store is honored by both
    flavors: kedro gets a feature_engineering Kedro pipeline plus matching catalog/parameters
    entries instead of native's feature engineering notebooks.
Default
